mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.35 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal a broad-based demand surge that accelerates inflation and forces the Fed to maintain high interest rates, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their thresholds, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and reduce equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both PAYEMS exceeds 157000.0 and UNRATE is below 3.7%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which leads the Fed to maintain high interest rates and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% annually signals strong economic momentum that increases corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
